Mission Local reported on May 25, 2025, that Alemany Farm was at risk of shutting down after one-time city funding ran out. The farm was facing a projected budget gap of $100,000 to $150,000, and had paused paid apprenticeship programs and reduced staff hours while fundraising.

The story also reported that Rec and Parks lets the farm use its land rent-free and provides services such as compost and water. In April, the Human Services Agency approved a $186,963 grant extension through June 2026.

Correction: An earlier version attributed the projected budget gap to the San Francisco Human Services Agency; the estimate came from Alemany Farm.
